annotatedSteps.description: Find distance BD in terms of h
annotatedSteps.studentWork: (i) In △BDC, tan 45° = CD/BD ⇒ 1 = h/BD ⇒ BD = h m

annotatedSteps.description: Find distance BC in terms of h
annotatedSteps.studentWork: (ii) sin 45° = CD/BC ⇒ 1/√2 = h/BC ⇒ BC = √2 h m

annotatedSteps.description: Calculate height CE of the lighthouse
annotatedSteps.studentWork: (iii) I don't know how to do this part.

teacherNote: Marked against: (i) Correct expression for BD in terms of h using tan 45° (1); (ii) Correct expression for BC in terms of h using sin 45° or Pythagoras theorem (1); (iii) Relation tan 60° = (h + 40)/h and solving for h (1); (iii) Calculating total height CE = h + 40 (1). Parts (i) and (ii) are completely correct and clearly written. For part (iii), relate the ground triangle △AEC using tan 60° = (h + 40)/h since AE = BD = h and DE = 40 m.
